ResearchProjectDef.label: Ha'tak mothership systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Scale Goa'uld mothership architecture into RimWorld Odyssey's native gravship framework: a pel'tac command deck, naquadah-based power, liquid-Naquadria propulsion, shield generators and Ha'tak structural systems. This research extends the existing Al'kesh/ONAC technology path rather than replacing it.
